articles.summary: Oracle, Bloom Energy and Roadrunner Food Bank of New Mexico today announced a new partnership to increase reliable access to nourishing food for families in Santa Teresa and Sunland Park, supported by a combined $400,000 contribution to Roadrunner Food Bank, including $250,000 from Oracle and $150,000 from Bloom Energy.
articles.title: Oracle and Bloom Energy Announce $400,000 in Support for Roadrunner Food Bank to Expand Food Access in Santa Teresa and Sunland Park
